lines.text: The ark stayed at Kiriath-jearim twenty years, and Israel put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.
Samuel gathered Israel at Mizpah, where they poured out water, fasted, and confessed that they had sinned against the LORD.
When the Philistine rulers marched up, the afraid Israelites begged Samuel to keep crying out, and he offered a suckling ram.
The LORD thundered against the Philistines, Israel struck them down to Beth-car, and Samuel named a stone Peniel.
Samuel judged Israel all his life, going yearly from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, then home to Ramah, where he built an altar.
